title: Mixed-Precision in adaptive Runge-Kutta method for large ODE systems
summary: Mixed-precision methods combine low and high precision arithmetics to exploit low precision computational speed and high precision accuracy. Large ODE systems that contain many heterogeneous interactions lead to a high computational cost that could be tackled with mixed-precision solvers. We tested mixedprecision versions of the Bogacki-Shampine 3(2) Runge-Kutta pair over three benchmark systems: coupled linear oscillators, the Kuramoto model and a circadian clock model.
